steps.title: Access Linear Developer Dashboard
steps.purpose: Establish application identity and access developer credentials.
steps.whereToGo: https://linear.app/settings/api > "Workspace Settings > Security & Access > API > Your OAuth Applications"
steps.instructions: Navigate to https://linear.app/settings/api. Sign in and go to: "Workspace Settings > Security & Access > API > Your OAuth Applications".
steps.howToVerify: Confirm browser loads the developer dashboard at "Workspace Settings > Security & Access > API > Your OAuth Applications".

steps.title: Register New OAuth Application in Linear
steps.purpose: Registers your client identity with the authorization server.
steps.whereToGo: https://linear.app/settings/api > "Linear Web App > Settings > API > "+ New Application""
steps.instructions: Click "Linear Web App > Settings > API > "+ New Application"". Complete the registration form fields: Application Name, Developer Website URL, Callback URLs, Public Application checkbox.
steps.expectedOutcome: Application created in developer console. Client ID is generated.
steps.howToVerify: Verify application entry appears in dashboard with generated Client ID.

steps.title: Configure Authorized Redirect URIs
steps.purpose: Prevents authorization code interception by locking callbacks to your server.
steps.instructions: In the redirect settings, enter your callback URL. For local development, enter your local callback URL (e.g. "http://localhost:3000/api/auth/callback/linear"). Note: The example uses http://localhost:3000 exclusively for local development testing; deployed staging and production applications require HTTPS matching the registered domain character-for-character. Must match registered callback URLs exactly. Localhost with any port (e.g. http://localhost:3000/callback) is permitted for dev.. Save changes.
steps.howToVerify: Confirm saved redirect URI appears under whitelisted callbacks with exact matching protocol.

steps.title: Select Permission Scopes & Secure Client Secret
steps.purpose: Configures granular API access permissions and obtains server credentials.
steps.instructions: Retrieve your Client ID and generate your Client Secret. Supported scopes: read (Read-only access to organization issues, comments, projects, and cycles.), write (Full create and update access to issues, attachments, comments, and project states.), issues:create (Granular scope allowing solely creation of new customer issues.), comments:create (Permits posting comments to issues without reading workspace history.), admin (Manage organization-level workspace settings and integrations.). Scope location rule: Linear configures scopes at authorization time via the scope query parameter.. Store Client Secret in backend environment variables.
steps.expectedOutcome: Client Secret securely placed in server environment.
steps.howToVerify: Verify Client Secret string is copied and referenced in server .env without exposing in client code.
steps.commandOrSnippet:
LINEAR_CLIENT_ID="your_client_id_here"
LINEAR_CLIENT_SECRET="[REDACTED_CLIENT_SECRET]"
# Note: http://localhost:3000 is used for local development testing only; deployed production applications require HTTPS
REDIRECT_URI="http://localhost:3000/api/auth/callback"

steps.title: Implement Linear Authorization & Token Exchange
steps.purpose: Complete standard OAuth 2.0 (Authorization Code Grant with PKCE) flow.
steps.whereToGo: Backend Callback Route & Client Auth Redirect Handler
steps.instructions: Direct users to authorization endpoint: "https://linear.app/oauth/authorize?client_id={CLIENT_ID}&response_type=code&redirect_uri={REDIRECT_URI}&scope=read%20write". Exchange authorization code by POSTing to token endpoint: "https://api.linear.app/oauth/token".
steps.expectedOutcome: Server receives JSON payload containing access_token, token_type: Bearer, and expiration.
steps.howToVerify: Execute test code exchange and verify response JSON has 200 OK with valid access_token.

troubleshooting.description: The requested scope string contains unrecognized or misspelled Linear permissions.
probableCauses: Requesting scopes with colon errors (e.g., issue:create instead of issues:create).
troubleshooting.resolution: Update the scope query param in your authorization URL to valid Linear scopes: "read,write".
troubleshooting.symptom: The requested scope string contains unrecognized or misspelled Linear permissions.
troubleshooting.diagnosis: Inspect request parameters against console configuration: Requesting scopes with colon errors (e.g., issue:create instead of issues:create).
troubleshooting.verification: Retry authorization request and confirm expected OAuth code or token response is returned.
troubleshooting.escalationPath: Capture provider error code and request details, excluding client secrets and access tokens, then consult Linear developer docs.

troubleshooting.description: The redirect_uri query parameter does not match the callback URL registered in Linear settings.
probableCauses: Missing port or trailing slash differences.
troubleshooting.resolution: Ensure the redirect_uri in your auth request character-for-character matches Linear Settings > API > Callback URLs.
troubleshooting.symptom: The redirect_uri query parameter does not match the callback URL registered in Linear settings.
troubleshooting.diagnosis: Inspect request parameters against console configuration: Protocol discrepancy (http vs https); Missing port or trailing slash differences.
troubleshooting.verification: Retry authorization request and confirm expected OAuth code or token response is returned.
troubleshooting.escalationPath: Capture provider error code and request details, excluding client secrets and access tokens, then consult Linear developer docs.
